subject: Where should we put this on your roadmap?
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@piedpiper.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Where should we put this on your roadmap?

Hi Samir,

Great to meet earlier — appreciate you walking through Pied Piper's inference bottlenecks. Quick recap from our discovery so it's easy to share internally: 

- Primary goal: reduce cost-per-inference for real-time recommendation model while holding latency <= 40ms p95.
- Current infra: mixed GPU fleet (mostly T4 / occasional V100), on-prem for sensitive traffic.
- Key constraints: SOC2+ audit evidence, private VPC option, and predictable latency for peak traffic windows.

Suggested pilot (minimal scope)
- 4-week pilot: baseline measurement, small-scale inference on 2 endpoints, cost/latency report, and recommend quantization/serving config.
- Success metrics: token cost reduction >= 30% or latency within 10% of baseline for 95% of requests.

Next steps
- If this maps to your priorities, I can schedule a 30-min scoping call with our solutions engineer next week to finalize pilot scope and SOW. Proposed windows: Tue/Wed 11–2 PT or Thu 8–11 PT.
- I attached a short one-pager that summarizes the pilot and what we typically deliver.

Attachment: pilot-scope.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

If this isn't a fit right now, quick flag and I'll pause outreach. Otherwise: which window works for you?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Rafael —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the clear summary. We're slammed closing out the year and leadership has asked us to hold on new pilots until Q2 planning. This project looks interesting but is deprioritized for the next 90 days.

Please pause outreach for now; no need to send materials to the broader team at this time. We can tentatively aim to revisit in early February (target: mid-February) once planning is underway.

Appreciate you checking in — I'll reach out if anything changes.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of ML Engineering | Pied Piper
samir@piedpiper.ai

Hi Samir —

Just closing the loop on this thread. I know you asked the team to pause new pilots through the quarter — totally understood. Quick options so I don't keep nudging forever: 

1) I can set a reminder to check back in mid-February and re-open the conversation on your timeline.
2) If you'd rather keep this on file but not be contacted, I can mark the opportunity as paused and check back in three months.
3) If you'd like a short one-pager or an internal-ready note I can share with your leadership when the time is right, I can drop that in (single slide).

If I don't hear back, I'll mark RWI-3247 as paused in our pipeline and circle back in February. If you'd prefer not to be contacted at all, reply with the word "unsubscribe" and I'll remove you from follow-ups.

CC'ing Marissa for visibility. If there's someone else on your side who should own next outreach, feel free to point me to them.

Appreciate your time — enjoy the holiday push and we'll reconnect when it's a better window.

Best,
